description:
350ml drip‑free glass oil dispenser with soft‑touch pump top makes cooking cleaner and more controlled. Press once and pour a measured stream—no messy trails down the bottle, no slippery countertop, and no guessing how much oil went into your pan or salad. The clear borosilicate glass body keeps your olive oil, vinegar, and dressings visible so you refill on time, while the olive‑green pump cap adds a modern, kitchen‑counter look.

This one‑hand pump design is perfect when you’re sautéing, flipping rotis, or mixing salad with the other hand. The wide mouth makes refilling easy (even from larger oil cans), and it’s simple to rinse and hand‑wash. A non‑slip base helps it stay put near the stove, so you get neat pours and faster cooking with less waste.

Drip‑free measured spout: Helps reduce over-pouring and oily bottle trails, making salads and sautéing cleaner and more consistent.
Borosilicate glass clarity: Keeps contents visible at a glance and resists staining for a cleaner look on the countertop.
350ml daily-use capacity: Ideal for olive oil, cooking oil, vinegar, soy sauce, and salad dressing without taking up too much space.
Wide-mouth refill + easy cleaning: Refill from larger tins or bottles and rinse easily for hygiene and odor control.
Non-slip base & hanging loop: Stays stable near the stove and can be hung for convenient storage.
